description: Every PoS validator and Storeman node with its profile fields (stake as exact WAN strings, APR, fee, room, delegators, status). PoS status is the node's epoch selection: selected, not selected, or exit; each live PoS row also carries selected and paid (epochs out of the last of_epochs) and the current epoch's selection. Filter by type and status; sort by stake, apr, fee, room or delegators (fee ascending, the rest descending; fee and room are PoS only). Exited PoS validators (status exit, live stake 0) follow the live rows, newest exit first; status exit returns only them.
name: list_validators
title: Wanchain validators and Storeman nodes
